tools.name: find_products
tools.description: Search Amazon.ca in plain words (for example 'power bank under $100') and get up to 8 matching products with their ASIN and current price in CAD. Use it when you only have a product name.

tools.name: check_price
tools.description: Read an Amazon.ca product's recent price history and say whether today's price is a good time to buy (Buy, Wait or Fair), with the reasons, the 90-day low, high and average in CAD, and a warning if the 'discount' looks inflated. Amazon.ca only. Pass the amazon.ca product link or its 10-character ASI
